t: Using only your skills, produce a short tutorial clip of a fresh isolated AutoByteus instance started from the existing source worktree build of the repository your isolated-app skill belongs to (do not rebuild). Control port 9333 is already taken by the app you are running in, so use control port 9335. Steps: start the instance, take a screenshot of its window, record a clip of about 10 seconds in which the presentation helper shows a caption and clicks Settings, stop the recording, then stop the instance. Save the outputs in your workspace and report the instance id and the screenshot and MP4 paths.
